title: Products
description: Products are isolated applications on this Axentra server, each with its own tenants, users and keys.
descriptionSingle: This server runs in single-product mode with exactly one product.

singleMode.title: Single-product mode
singleMode.body: The server creates its one product from its configuration. Products cannot be created, archived or restored in this mode; to run several products, an operator sets mode = "multi" in the server configuration.

create.title: Create product
create.description: A product gets its own tenants, users, roles and API keys.
create.slugHelp: URL-friendly identifier, derived from the name. Must be unique on this server.
create.slugInfo: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes (2–63 characters), starting with a letter or digit. The slug appears in URLs and configuration and cannot be changed later.

empty.title: No products yet
empty.body: You are not a member of any product. Ask a platform administrator for access.
empty.bodyAdmin: Create the first product to start managing tenants and users.

settings.title: Product settings
settings.description: Changes apply immediately to all tenants of this product.
settings.readOnly: You can view but not change these settings.
settings.jsonHelp: Product-specific configuration as a JSON object.
settings.mustBeObject: Settings must be a JSON object, for example {"key": "value"}.
settings.jsonInfo: Your product code can read these values. Axentra uses some keys itself: invitation_accept_url (link in invitation emails), default_locale (fallback language of notifications) and storage (set on the Files tab). Saving replaces the whole object; it may be up to about 32,000 characters long.

lifecycle.archiveBody: “{{name}}” is hidden from its operators and tenant members, and its API keys stop working until it is restored. Platform administrators keep access. No data is deleted.
lifecycle.archivedNotice: This product is archived: its operators, tenant members and API keys have no access. Restore it to make changes.
lifecycle.singleMode: The server runs in single-product mode, so this product cannot be archived. You can change its name, description, settings and members.

membersDescription: Operators of this product. Their role applies in every tenant; tenant members are managed on each tenant.
invitationsDescription: Invite operators by email to join this product's team. After accepting, they have the product role in every tenant.
